nextStoryContext: rewriteFrontmatterEffort's insert path (src/templates/frontmatter.ts) now uses content.replace(/^---\r?\n[\s\S]*?\r?\n---/, () => updatedFence) -- a no-arg replacer function -- instead of passing updatedFence as a string replacement, so any $-sequences ($&, $1, $$) captured in frontmatterBody are inserted verbatim per MDN's documented replacer-function semantics. The existing-line rewrite branch (line ~80, `content.replace(/^(effort:)\s*.+$/m, \`$1 ${newEffort}\`)`) intentionally keeps the string-replacement form since `$1` there refers to the regex's own capture group, not to arbitrary user content -- do not "fix" that branch too.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed MDN: when replace()'s 2nd arg is a function, the returned string is used verbatim -- $-patterns are NOT reinterpreted, matching the fix applied.
